name: Wellness
overview: Scripture reveals that true wellness is rooted in a faithful relationship with the LORD, marked by obedience to His commands and reverence for Him, which brings physical healing and protection from disease (Exodus 15:26; 23:25). The psalmist acknowledges the wondrous design of the human body as God’s handiwork, encouraging praise and trust in His healing power for both physical and emotional brokenness (Psalms 139:14; 147:3). Wisdom to fear the LORD and avoid evil supports holistic well-being, while encouragement through kind words uplifts the spirit, demonstrating that wellness encompasses body, soul, and heart (Proverbs 3:7; 12:25).
